Title of the Event:  
 Live e co friendly seed ball making workshop for club members as well as entire college students . 
Sponsored by SPICES, an AICTE initiative, organized by Arts& Crafts club.

04-01-2023 (Wednesday)

10:00 AM to 4:00 PM

Associate Professor of English

 Dr. N.Sudhakar Reddy 
Principal,  
SV College of Engineering, 
Tirupati, A.P. – 517507. 
Event Description:  
 Arts & Crafts club, SVCE with the support of department of English conducted one day Live Eco 
friendly seed ba ll making  workshop for club members as well as entire college students, s ponsored by 
SPICES an AICTE initiative organized by Arts & Crafts club. The chief guest Dr.  N. Sudhakar Reddy 
explained how the nature is being destroyed with the name of development  which leads to  the percentage of 
trees is getting  reduced and leads to ecological im balance. Hence, we t hought to support the nature to  some 
extent with an idea of making ‘Seed Balls’.  
           The workshop influenced the students much to know  the value of trees and greenery. We dropped the 
dried seed ba lls in the deserted areas of our locality to grow trees seasonally. Along with the club membe rs 

other students also took part in this with great enthusiasm and made it a grand success.  We bought two loads of 
fertile soil and 40 Kgs of variety seeds like Pipal, Tamarind, Neem, Banyan, Gift tree, Guava etc.  
Targeted Audience:  
1st, 2nd and 3rdYear Students.
